name: EXM_EXPENSE_VIOLATIONS
description: This table contains information about expense violations.

columns.name: EXPENSE_VIOLATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific policy violation for an expense report.

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense report with policy violations.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense with policy violations.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person on the expense report.

columns.name: SUPERVISOR_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the supervisor of the person on the expense report.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: A grouping of expense types and additional data fields that are relevant for a particular grouping of expenses. An example is airfare.

columns.name: VIOLATION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of policy violation, such as receipt missing and corporate card required.

columns.name: VIOLATION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the policy violation was identified.

columns.name: EXCEEDED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount by which the expense exceeded the allowable amount limit causing a policy violation.

columns.name: ALLOWABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount allowed for the expense type by the company policy.

columns.name: FUNC_CURRENCY_ALLOWABLE_AMT
columns.description: Amount allowed for the expense type by the company policy in functional currency.

columns.name: DISPLAY_TO_USER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether policy violations should be displayed to the user.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: VIOLATION_SOURCE
columns.description: Source identified the policy violation, such as expense entry and audit.
